description.en-US: The Grounds of Faith (1852): four lectures delivered at St. George's, Southwark, on the foundation of Christian faith: revealed truth definite and certain, the Church as a historical witness and as a divine witness, and rationalism as the legitimate consequence of private judgment.
description.pt-BR: Os Fundamentos da Fé (1852): quatro conferências pronunciadas em St. George, Southwark, sobre o fundamento da fé cristã: a verdade revelada, definida e certa, a Igreja como testemunha histórica e como testemunha divina, e o racionalismo como consequência legítima do livre exáme.

en-US.editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Lambert, 1852)

sources.edition: The Grounds of Faith (London: Burns and Lambert, 1852), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The four lectures; the contents and the publisher's list of books are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning died in 1892 and the edition is of 1852, so the text is public domain.
